steps.content:
June 1
Chief's Office
Your communication screen has been flashing non-stop with incoming messages for a while now.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Chief... Would you mind coming over? We've got a situation here! QAQ

<color=#fb9259>Eugene:</color>...Chief, help me out, please! If this doesn't stop now, I'm gonna lose my life savings!

<color=#fb9259>Eugene:</color>Help, Chief!!!

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Chief!! Chief!!! Check your phone, I beg you!!! TAT
When you see the SOS messages, you rush to the scene at once.
You arrive to find a particularly tiny figure laughing smugly, arms akimbo.
She's surrounded by staff with agonized expressions alongside heaps of trophies. The moment they see you, the two city arrest team members dash to you as if they're grabbing a lifeline.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Boohoo, Chief, here you are finally! You have no idea what I've just been through!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief... Does this count as a workplace injury?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, one more round, one more round! Roulecca isn't done yet!
Feeling the tiny figure's attention turning toward you lot, the two immediately hide behind you fearfully.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Is it you, Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Of course it's me, you idiot, Chief! Don't tell me just because I've shrunk a little, you don't recognize Roulecca, the cutest girl in the world?
What happened to you?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm, I couldn't resist and ate a piece of Summer's cake this morning, and suddenly I turned into a child... I think some others ate that cake too!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Anyway, enough with that small matter... Roulecca just wants to keep playing!
The tiny Roulecca claps her hands to signal the start of another round of the game. The people around her immediately cover their pockets and beg you for help with their eyes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Um, Roulecca, you know, they can't just ignore their tasks and play with you all day...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I don't care, it's Day of Youth today! Endless sweets and endless games, hehe, the privilege of being a child!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I won't stop unless... I win my dream prize!
Watching her sulk like a little kid, you come up with an idea.
Let them go, I'll play with you. And whether you win or lose, I'll gift you a teddy bear.
You take out the toy Faye has purchased for Day of Youth and wave it in front of Roulecca.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...A teddy bear!
You manage to impress the girl with the plush teddy bear. She goes on to announce cheerfully.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Alrighty, then let's play... Cookie Guess!
